market.question: Will George Russell be the 2026 F1 Drivers' Champion?

assessment.reasoning: After 3 rounds of 2026 F1 season, standings: Antonelli 72-75 (leader), Russell 63-68 (P2, ~7pt deficit). Russell is in title contention as Mercedes appears competitive. With ~21+ races remaining, Russell has real chance but is behind teammate and faces strong field (Verstappen, Norris, Leclerc all in mix). Implied probability for any single non-leader to win the title is typically 15-25%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Team performance trajectory; how Antonelli holds up under pressure as a rookie.
